cues.title: 为什么有的分子更容易进去？
cues.titleEn: Why do some molecules enter more readily?
cues.caption: 先进入脂质，再穿膜：这是成分线索。
cues.captionEn: Entering lipid helps a molecule cross.
cues.zh: 同样的条件下，有的物质更容易进入细胞。欧文顿注意到，容易溶于脂质的物质往往也更容易穿膜。把屏障放大：在这个被动扩散模型里，分子要先进入脂质，再从另一面离开。其它条件相同时，更容易进入脂质，初始穿越也就更快。这支持膜含脂质，却不能告诉我们它排了几层。
cues.en: Under matched conditions, some substances enter cells more readily. Overton connected this behavior with lipid solubility. Zoom into an explanatory barrier: in this passive diffusion model, a molecule enters the lipid phase before leaving from the other side. With other factors fixed, easier entry into lipid increases initial passage. This supports a lipid component, but does not tell us how many layers there are.

cues.title: 为什么约两倍面积支持双层？
cues.titleEn: Why does roughly twice the area support two layers?
cues.caption: 先测面积，再检验一层和两层的预测。
cues.captionEn: Measure first; test one or two layers.
cues.zh: 膜太薄，看不清层数，可以先量面积。原研究把红细胞的总表面积，与提取脂质铺成单层的面积比较，后者约是前者的两倍。现在才比较假说：若原来只有一层，同样的分子占地应得到一倍面积；若有两层，就应得到两倍。把同一批分子折回两排，恰好说明这个关系。头接触水，尾藏在内部，也符合磷脂的两亲性。但如果提取时丢失脂质，面积比就会偏小，所以约两倍是有前提的证据。
cues.en: The membrane is too thin to resolve, so measure areas first. The original study compared estimated red-cell surface area with the area of extracted lipids spread into one layer. The latter was roughly twice as large. Now compare hypotheses. With equal molecular footprints, one original layer predicts one area; two layers predict twice that area. Folding the same molecules into two rows explains the relationship. Water-facing heads and inward tails also suit their amphiphilic nature. But losing lipid during extraction lowers the ratio: this evidence depends on its assumptions.

cues.title: 张力低，就能画出蛋白质外套吗？
cues.titleEn: Does low tension prove a protein coat?
cues.caption: 吸附能改变张力，却不能唯一确定排列。
cues.captionEn: Lower tension does not locate proteins.
cues.zh: 细胞表面的张力较低，是什么改变了界面？比较同样的油水界面：蛋白质吸附后，张力可以降低。这给研究者一个解释，膜中可能还有蛋白质。注意，能解释张力降低，并不等于已经看见蛋白质在哪里。同一个宏观结果，可能对应不同排列。要画出膜的结构，还需要新的证据。
cues.en: What changes an interface with low tension? Compare matched oil–water interfaces: adsorbed protein can lower their tension. This suggested a protein contribution to the cell surface. But explaining a lower tension does not locate the proteins. The same macroscopic result can be compatible with different arrangements. A structural model needs further evidence.

cues.title: 看见三条带，就知道三层成分吗？
cues.titleEn: Do three image bands identify three chemical layers?
cues.caption: 明暗不是成分标签，还需独立证据。
cues.captionEn: Contrast alone cannot name a substance.
cues.zh: 电镜里出现暗、亮、暗三条带，是否就能说两边都是蛋白质？先区分图像与解释。下面的曲线只记录明暗变化；让成像变模糊，条带也跟着改变，膜的成分却没有因此变化。过去的三层假说试图解释这幅图，但暗带本身没有写着蛋白质。更清楚的图像仍要和其它证据一起判断。
cues.en: Dark, light, dark: does that prove a protein layer on each side? Separate the image from its interpretation. The profile records contrast. Broaden the imaging response and the bands blur, without changing the modeled composition. The historical layered hypothesis tried to explain such images, but a dark band does not carry a chemical name. Even sharper images need independent evidence.

cues.title: 颜色混合，排除了哪一种膜？
cues.titleEn: What does marker mixing rule out?
cues.caption: 固定预测仍分区，混合观察支持可动。
cues.captionEn: Fixed markers stay apart; observed markers mix.
cues.zh: 在不同时间取样，融合细胞的两种来源标记，起初分区，后来混合。如果位置都固定，四十分钟后仍应分区，这与观察不符。现在换成侧向运动的解释模型：带环标记保留来源，只是随机改变位置。这条一维闭合路径不是原实验的连续轨迹。原研究还用抑制处理检验其它解释。可以移动，也不等于每个蛋白都毫无限制。固定一个，其余还会混合吗？
cues.en: Samples taken at different times show the two origins initially separated, then mixed. Fixed positions predict continued separation after forty minutes, unlike the observation. Now switch to an explanatory motion model. The ringed marker retains its origin while moving randomly. This one-dimensional closed path is not a continuous historical recording. The original study also tested alternatives with inhibitors. Mobility does not mean every protein is unrestricted. Anchor one: can the others still mix?

cues.title: 怎样把不同证据放进同一张膜？
cues.titleEn: How can one membrane model satisfy different evidence?
cues.caption: 面积、亲疏水与运动共同约束结构。
cues.captionEn: Area, water affinity and motion constrain structure.
cues.zh: 一个好的膜模型，要同时解释不同证据。提取脂质的约两倍面积支持双层；来源标记能混合，说明膜成分可以移动。再看分子的性质：亲水头接触两侧的水，疏水尾留在内部。蛋白质的性质和定位研究还支持不同嵌入方式，不能只靠融合实验确定它们的深度。流动镶嵌把这些约束放在一起：位置可以变，头尾方向和内外关系仍然保持。
cues.en: A membrane model must satisfy different evidence. The roughly doubled extracted-lipid area supports a bilayer; marker mixing supports mobility. Molecular properties add another constraint: hydrophilic heads contact water, while nonpolar tails remain inside. Protein properties and localization studies support different embedding arrangements; fusion alone does not establish their depth. The fluid mosaic combines these constraints. Positions may change while molecular orientation and the distinction between inside and outside remain.

cues.title: 做得像，还是解释得通？
cues.titleEn: Does the model explain, or merely resemble?
cues.caption: 用证据检验模型，也检验它的局限。
cues.captionEn: Evidence tests a model and its limits.
cues.zh: 用废旧材料做一张膜，怎样判断它解释得对不对？先把水的位置标出来：头应该接触水，尾不能朝外暴露。数量相同，方向错了仍然不合适。再用标记混合来检验：固定铁丝能表示双层，却不能展示分子换邻居。怎样让连接允许侧向移动，同时保持头尾方向？模型的价值，是保留要解释的关系，并说清它省略了什么。
cues.en: How do we judge a membrane built from reused materials? Mark the water first. Heads should contact it, with tails shielded inside. The same number of pieces in the wrong orientation is still unsuitable. Now test behavior against marker mixing. Rigid wire represents a bilayer but prevents components from changing neighbors. Could a movable connection preserve orientation while allowing lateral motion? A useful model retains the relationships it explains and states what it leaves out.

question.zh: 看不清细胞膜，怎样知道它长什么样？
question.en: How can we infer a membrane too thin to see?

description.zh: 用面积、界面、图像和标记运动逐步检验膜结构假说。
description.en: Test membrane hypotheses through areas, interfaces, images and moving markers.

originalTitle.zh: 欧文顿的细胞通透性实验

question.zh: 穿膜快慢为什么能提示膜的成分？
question.en: How can entry rates give clues to membrane composition?

principle.zh: 在其它条件相同的被动扩散模型中，进入脂质相的能力影响通透率；这支持膜含脂质，不决定层数。
principle.en: With other factors fixed, partition into lipid affects passive permeability. This supports a lipid component, not a layer count.

question.zh: 只增加脂溶性而保持其它参数相同，初始进入会怎样变化？
question.en: With other parameters fixed, how would greater lipid affinity change initial entry?

explanation.zh: 在固定膜厚、扩散系数及初始浓度的模型中，K 增大会提高 P = DK/h 和初始净通量；真实分子还受尺寸、电荷和转运蛋白等影响。
explanation.en: With thickness, diffusivity and initial concentrations fixed, larger K increases P = DK/h and initial net flux. Real molecules also depend on size, charge and transport proteins.

originalTitle.en: Spreading lipids extracted from red blood cells

question.zh: 看不清的膜，怎样用面积推断层数？
question.en: How can area measurements test an unseen membrane structure?

principle.zh: 在完整提取和可比较占地的前提下，约2倍铺展面积更符合两层候选；观测与假说必须分开。
principle.en: With complete extraction and comparable molecular footprints, roughly doubled spreading area favors a two-layer hypothesis.

question.zh: 若丢失一部分提取脂质，测出的面积比会偏向哪边？
question.en: If some extracted lipid is lost, which way does the measured area ratio shift?

explanation.zh: 脂质丢失会让 B 变小而 A 不变，使 B/A 偏低；所以相同面积比可能来自不同层数与提取效率，不能无条件唯一反推结构。
explanation.en: Lost lipid lowers B while A stays fixed, reducing B/A. Different layer counts and extraction efficiencies can yield the same ratio, so the ratio does not uniquely identify structure without assumptions.

originalTitle.zh: 细胞表面张力与膜蛋白假说
originalTitle.en: Surface tension and the membrane-protein hypothesis

question.zh: 为什么低张力让研究者想到蛋白质？
question.en: Why did low interfacial tension suggest a protein contribution?

principle.zh: 蛋白吸附可以解释界面张力降低；单个宏观量不能唯一反推蛋白质排列。
principle.en: Protein adsorption can explain lower tension, but one macroscopic property does not uniquely locate the proteins.

question.zh: 只测出相同的低张力，能区分不同蛋白排列吗？
question.en: Can the same low tension alone distinguish different protein arrangements?

explanation.zh: 不能。张力是整体界面性质，单个数值并不提供蛋白的位置与覆盖连续性；还需独立结构证据。
explanation.en: No. Tension is a macroscopic interfacial property. One value does not locate proteins or establish a continuous coat; independent structural evidence is needed.

originalTitle.zh: 电镜下的细胞膜三层结构
originalTitle.en: Three-layer membrane contrast in electron microscopy

question.zh: 一张暗—亮—暗的图，能证明什么？
question.en: What does a dark–light–dark image actually establish?

principle.zh: 暗亮对比与化学身份是不同信息；更清晰的图像仍须与独立证据结合。
principle.en: Image contrast and chemical identity are different information; sharper images still need independent evidence.

question.zh: 把同一图像变清楚，是否就能单凭暗带确认蛋白质？
question.en: Would a sharper version of the same image identify the dark material as protein?

explanation.zh: 不能。清晰度改善的是对比度分布的分辨能力，成分名称仍需要独立标记或化学证据。
explanation.en: No. Sharper imaging resolves the contrast distribution better, but chemical identity still requires independent labeling or chemical evidence.

originalTitle.zh: 荧光标记的小鼠细胞和人细胞融合实验
originalTitle.en: Fluorescent markers in mouse–human cell fusion

question.zh: 人和小鼠来源的标记，为什么后来不再各占一半？
question.en: Why do human and mouse markers stop occupying separate halves?

principle.zh: 固定位置预测保持分区，而观测到标记混合，支持膜成分能够移动。
principle.en: Fixed positions predict persistent separation; observed marker mixing supports mobility.

question.zh: 如果只固定住一部分蛋白，其余标签仍可能混合吗？
question.en: If only some proteins are anchored, can the remaining markers still mix?

explanation.zh: 可以。在示意模型中固定一枚不会阻止其他标记扩散；流动性并不意味着所有膜蛋白无约束自由运动。
explanation.en: Yes. Anchoring one marker does not stop the others from diffusing in the model. Fluidity does not imply unrestricted motion of every membrane protein.

originalTitle.zh: 细胞膜的流动镶嵌结构
originalTitle.en: The fluid mosaic structure of cell membranes

question.zh: 双层、镶嵌和流动，各解决了什么问题？
question.en: What do a bilayer, embedded proteins and mobility each explain?

principle.zh: 面积、分子亲疏水性质和运动证据共同约束模型，任何单个实验都不足以包办全部结构。
principle.en: Area, molecular water affinity and mobility constrain the model together; no single experiment determines the whole structure.

question.zh: 把两层的头尾翻转，还是同样数量的分子，模型为什么不合适？
question.en: Why does flipping the same number of lipids make the model unsuitable?

explanation.zh: 倒置会使疏水尾暴露于水，亲水头藏进膜芯，违反两亲性与环境相容性的约束；数量相同不能补偿朝向错误。
explanation.en: Reversal exposes nonpolar tails to water and buries hydrophilic heads in the core. The same number of molecules cannot compensate for unsuitable orientation.

originalTitle.zh: 利用废旧物品制作生物膜模型
originalTitle.en: Build a biological membrane model from reused materials

question.zh: 一个漂亮的固定模型，为什么仍不足以表现真实膜？
question.en: Why is an attractive rigid model still incomplete?

principle.zh: 模型需保留它要解释的空间关系；固定教具能表示双层，但不能完整表示分子侧向运动。
principle.en: A model should preserve the relationships it explains. Rigid materials represent a bilayer but omit lateral molecular motion.

question.zh: 怎样改动连接方式，既保留双层方向又允许标记改变邻居？
question.en: How could a connection preserve bilayer orientation while allowing markers to change neighbors?

explanation.zh: 让连接保留每层头朝水的方向，同时允许标记沿层内滑动，可以表现更多空间与运动关系；这仍不是实际膜的分子动力学。
explanation.en: A connection can preserve water-facing heads while allowing in-plane sliding, representing more spatial and dynamic relations. It still does not reproduce molecular dynamics of a real membrane.

question.zh: 看不清细胞膜，怎样知道它长什么样？
question.en: How can we infer a membrane too thin to see?

lead.zh: 用面积、界面、图像和标记运动逐步检验膜结构假说。
lead.en: Test membrane hypotheses through areas, interfaces, images and moving markers.

principle.zh: 结构模型要同时满足独立面积、界面、成像与运动证据；观测和解释必须分开。
principle.en: A structural model must satisfy independent area, interface, image and mobility evidence; observations and interpretations remain distinct.

question.zh: 若丢失一部分提取脂质，测出的面积比会偏向哪边？
question.en: If some extracted lipid is lost, which way does the measured area ratio shift?

explanation.zh: 脂质丢失会让 B 变小而 A 不变，使 B/A 偏低；所以相同面积比可能来自不同层数与提取效率，不能无条件唯一反推结构。
explanation.en: Lost lipid lowers B while A stays fixed, reducing B/A. Different layer counts and extraction efficiencies can yield the same ratio, so the ratio does not uniquely identify structure without assumptions.

title.en: Why do some molecules enter more readily?

caption.en: Entering lipid helps a molecule cross.

question.en: How can entry rates give clues to membrane composition?

storyboard.phenomenon: 相同起始浓度下，两类中性溶质的胞内积累快慢不同；并列保持外界条件、体积及示意分子大小一致。
storyboard.evidence: 脂溶性与被动通透性相关，先显示观测关系再打开推理用脂质屏障截面。
storyboard.bridge: 限定相同膜厚、面积、扩散能力的溶解—扩散教学模型：进入疏水相的分配倾向改变有效通透率。不能用快慢直接推出双层、只含脂质或所有分子都遵从同一排序。

prediction.zh: 只增加脂溶性而保持其它参数相同，初始进入会怎样变化？

beats.name: matched-entry
beats.visual: 两条具有相同横轴的胞内积累曲线/容器体积；膜内部尚不可见。
beats.causalPurpose: 先识别需要解释的速度差。

beats.name: partition-bridge
beats.visual: 观察镜头缩入同一薄屏障，明确标“解释模型”；同尺寸不同颜色的中性分子在水/脂质边界交换，展示进入脂质相的差异，不画膜主动挑选。
beats.causalPurpose: 用分配性质连接脂溶性与穿越，不再只给两条不同指数曲线。

beats.name: predict-permeability
beats.visual: 保持膜厚和大小，改变一个分子的分配参数，计算的初始净通量随之变化。
beats.causalPurpose: 显示模型可作新预测。

beats.name: scope
beats.visual: 屏障保持未指定层数的薄层；保留“支持含脂质”简短结论。
beats.causalPurpose: 此证据不决定层数。

draftNarration.zh: 同样的条件下，有的物质更容易进入细胞。欧文顿注意到，容易溶于脂质的物质往往也更容易穿膜。把屏障放大：在这个被动扩散模型里，分子要先进入脂质，再从另一面离开。其它条件相同时，更容易进入脂质，初始穿越也就更快。这支持膜含脂质，却不能告诉我们它排了几层。
draftNarration.en: Under matched conditions, some substances enter cells more readily. Overton connected this behavior with lipid solubility. Zoom into an explanatory barrier: in this passive diffusion model, a molecule enters the lipid phase before leaving from the other side. With other factors fixed, easier entry into lipid increases initial passage. This supports a lipid component, but does not tell us how many layers there are.

caption.zh: 先测面积，再检验一层和两层的预测。
caption.en: Measure first; test one or two layers.

question.zh: 看不清的膜，怎样用面积推断层数？
question.en: How can area measurements test an unseen membrane structure?

storyboard.phenomenon: 红细胞总表面积与提取脂质的单分子层面积分别测量；单层约占前者两倍。起始细胞膜必须是未解析灰色轮廓，禁止开场先画两层。
storyboard.evidence: Gorter–Grendel 1925 Table I human rows 18/19: estimated total cell area 0.47 m², spread lipid areas 0.92 and 0.89 m². 两条数据保留相同面积基准，以0.92/0.47≈1.96作主帧，0.89/0.47≈1.89放可展开原表。
storyboard.bridge: 在相同分子占地、完整提取与可靠面积估计的理想条件下：一层候选预测单层面积约A，两层候选预测约2A。先比较预测，再展示亲水头朝水、疏水尾避水的两层解释。

prediction.zh: 若丢失一部分提取脂质，测出的面积比会偏向哪边？
prediction.en: If some extracted lipid is lost, which way does the measured area ratio shift?

beats.name: independent-measurements
beats.visual: 左为未知内部结构的红细胞集合及总表面积A；右为提取后铺展的水槽。桌面两对象并列，手机先测A后同基准显示B。显示原表人细胞样本A=0.47、B=0.92，不伪造原始照片或现代精度。
beats.causalPurpose: 先建立独立观测，不从预设双层推导结果。

beats.name: candidate-predictions
beats.visual: 观测B固定；一层/两层候选用同一横轴与同一原膜面积A分别预测0.47/0.94。候选为空心示意，观测是实色，避免混为数据。
beats.causalPurpose: 两种假说有不同、可检验的预测。

beats.name: conserved-footprints
beats.visual: 切到显式“理想分子模型”：40个既有脂质身份从观测单层折回两排20个，保持每个占地与尾长；一个棕色头可追踪。旁边一层候选需要2A宽，不能装进A。
beats.causalPurpose: 同一批分子为什么可以用两层覆盖原面积。

beats.name: water-orientation
beats.visual: 只在此时显示膜两侧都是水，亲水头接水、疏水尾向内；水槽界面头向下接水、尾向上朝空气。
beats.causalPurpose: 连接几何推断与两亲性，不能先把答案藏在初态。

beats.name: loss-prediction
beats.visual: 历史 A/B 始终只读。独立假想损失模型用相同 A 比较“完整收集预测”与“当前收集预测”的同宽面积；减少收集比例让后者面积变小，不改写1925观测数据。
beats.causalPurpose: 展示证据前提的重要性；不是把任意误差当真实历史数值。

draftNarration.zh: 膜太薄，看不清层数，可以先量面积。原研究把红细胞的总表面积，与提取脂质铺成单层的面积比较，后者约是前者的两倍。现在才比较假说：若原来只有一层，同样的分子占地应得到一倍面积；若有两层，就应得到两倍。把同一批分子折回两排，恰好说明这个关系。头接触水，尾藏在内部，也符合磷脂的两亲性。但如果提取时丢失脂质，面积比就会偏小，所以约两倍是有前提的证据。
draftNarration.en: The membrane is too thin to resolve, so measure areas first. The original study compared estimated red-cell surface area with the area of extracted lipids spread into one layer. The latter was roughly twice as large. Now compare hypotheses. With equal molecular footprints, one original layer predicts one area; two layers predict twice that area. Folding the same molecules into two rows explains the relationship. Water-facing heads and inward tails also suit their amphiphilic nature. But losing lipid during extraction lowers the ratio: this evidence depends on its assumptions.

title.zh: 张力低，就能画出蛋白质外套吗？
title.en: Does low tension prove a protein coat?

caption.zh: 吸附能改变张力，却不能唯一确定排列。
caption.en: Lower tension does not locate proteins.

question.zh: 为什么低张力让研究者想到蛋白质？
question.en: Why did low interfacial tension suggest a protein contribution?

storyboard.phenomenon: 教材先给细胞表面张力较油—水界面低这一观测，再给蛋白吸附可使油—水界面张力降低的类比。
storyboard.evidence: 保持几何一致的油滴界面示意，吸附前后比较；细胞张力只用教材定性观察，不伪造数值、误称细胞等于油滴。
storyboard.bridge: 蛋白吸附改变界面性质，是可能原因；同一个宏观张力无法反推蛋白一定铺成连续两层。

prediction.zh: 只测出相同的低张力，能区分不同蛋白排列吗？
prediction.en: Can the same low tension alone distinguish different protein arrangements?

beats.name: low-tension-clue
beats.visual: “细胞表面较低”的教材观测与清洁油—水界面并列，未显示膜的蛋白位置。
beats.causalPurpose: 提出需要解释的差异。

beats.name: adsorption
beats.visual: 相同半径油滴、同一水相；亲水/疏水区域明确的蛋白在界面吸附，界面张力示意标尺下降。
beats.causalPurpose: 可见变化发生在界面，支持候选原因。

beats.name: mechanical-balance
beats.visual: 保留同R截面，显示压力推力与沿边界张力合力；ΔP=2γ/R仅放探索/展开，watch只显示张力减弱。
beats.causalPurpose: 让模型的力学量与界面状态相关联，不凭箭头长度装饰。

beats.name: not-unique
beats.visual: 连续外套与局部吸附两个灰色候选共享“可能降低张力”的信息，均不打验证勾。
beats.causalPurpose: 张力不是蛋白位置或连续外套的充分证据。

draftNarration.zh: 细胞表面的张力较低，是什么改变了界面？比较同样的油水界面：蛋白质吸附后，张力可以降低。这给研究者一个解释，膜中可能还有蛋白质。注意，能解释张力降低，并不等于已经看见蛋白质在哪里。同一个宏观结果，可能对应不同排列。要画出膜的结构，还需要新的证据。
draftNarration.en: What changes an interface with low tension? Compare matched oil–water interfaces: adsorbed protein can lower their tension. This suggested a protein contribution to the cell surface. But explaining a lower tension does not locate the proteins. The same macroscopic result can be compatible with different arrangements. A structural model needs further evidence.

title.zh: 看见三条带，就知道三层成分吗？
title.en: Do three image bands identify three chemical layers?

caption.zh: 明暗不是成分标签，还需独立证据。
caption.en: Contrast alone cannot name a substance.

question.zh: 一张暗—亮—暗的图，能证明什么？
question.en: What does a dark–light–dark image actually establish?

storyboard.phenomenon: 显示教材式电子显微成像重建的暗亮暗，观察者容易直接贴上蛋白—脂质—蛋白名字。
storyboard.evidence: 保持同一对比度来源，改变成像展宽得到更模糊图；清晰度与化学身份是不同信息。
storyboard.bridge: 图像反映电子对比与制样，不是化学成分直接标签；模型须接受成分与动态研究的独立约束。

prediction.zh: 把同一图像变清楚，是否就能单凭暗带确认蛋白质？
prediction.en: Would a sharper version of the same image identify the dark material as protein?

beats.name: contrast
beats.visual: 一条略弯膜断面的灰度带与垂直于膜的短取样线，展开为同轴对比度剖面；保留尺度/示意标注。
beats.causalPurpose: 先看到观测是什么。

beats.name: tempting-labels
beats.visual: 蛋白—脂质—蛋白名字以虚线候选标注出现，标“解释假说”，不得变成已证实图例。
beats.causalPurpose: 揭示观测到成分之间多出了一步。

beats.name: same-object-new-response
beats.visual: 同一模型对比源仅增大高斯展宽，暗峰变宽并合；下方剖面与上方像素同一数据。
beats.causalPurpose: 画面变化可能来自成像条件。

beats.name: independent-test
beats.visual: 恢复清晰图，候选成分仍带问号；提示需要成分/运动证据而非再看一遍暗线。
beats.causalPurpose: 更清晰并不自动解决成分识别。

draftNarration.zh: 电镜里出现暗、亮、暗三条带，是否就能说两边都是蛋白质？先区分图像与解释。下面的曲线只记录明暗变化；让成像变模糊，条带也跟着改变，膜的成分却没有因此变化。过去的三层假说试图解释这幅图，但暗带本身没有写着蛋白质。更清楚的图像仍要和其它证据一起判断。
draftNarration.en: Dark, light, dark: does that prove a protein layer on each side? Separate the image from its interpretation. The profile records contrast. Broaden the imaging response and the bands blur, without changing the modeled composition. The historical layered hypothesis tried to explain such images, but a dark band does not carry a chemical name. Even sharper images need independent evidence.

title.zh: 颜色混合，排除了哪一种膜？
title.en: What does marker mixing rule out?

caption.zh: 固定预测仍分区，混合观察支持可动。
caption.en: Fixed markers stay apart; observed markers mix.

question.zh: 人和小鼠来源的标记，为什么后来不再各占一半？
question.en: Why do human and mouse markers stop occupying separate halves?

storyboard.phenomenon: 融合后5min与40min的标记分布重建；37℃来自原研究。历史图示以颜色区/亮点群表现群体分布，不伪装逐个蛋白原始轨迹。
storyboard.evidence: 人/鼠两种来源标记由分区变混合；固定位置的反事实模型仍分区。原研究抑制蛋白合成仍混合、降温抑制混合的结果在折叠文字中作为进一步检验。
storyboard.bridge: 分布变化挑战静态刚性模型；可见单个身份轨迹是侧向扩散解释，不声称原实验追踪了该分子或完全排除所有替代路径。

prediction.zh: 如果只固定住一部分蛋白，其余标签仍可能混合吗？
prediction.en: If only some proteins are anchored, can the remaining markers still mix?

beats.name: historical-observation
beats.visual: 5 min 与 40 min 不同取样时刻的代表分布重建；两个样本并列。无同一细胞形变与连续ID，37℃只属于历史观察框。
beats.causalPurpose: 建立实际需要解释的分布变化。

beats.name: frozen-counterfactual
beats.visual: 给相同初态加“若位置固定”的灰色模型，40min仍分区；与观察结果相反。
beats.causalPurpose: 静态假说作出可反驳预测。

beats.name: trace-explanation
beats.visual: 打开标“解释模型”的膜表面，圆/菱形两来源稳定ID，一个加环；种子侧向扩散可回放，互相穿越不丢失身份，不设朝另一颜色的目标。
beats.causalPurpose: 显示混合可由随机侧向移动产生，颜色不需要互相转化。

beats.name: partial-anchor
beats.visual: 固定一个带钉标记，其他身份继续侧向运动；无全膜集体机械摆动。
beats.causalPurpose: 流动不等于每个分子都完全自由。

draftNarration.zh: 在不同时间取样，融合细胞的两种来源标记，起初分区，后来混合。如果位置都固定，四十分钟后仍应分区，这与观察不符。现在换成侧向运动的解释模型：带环标记保留来源，只是随机改变位置。这条一维闭合路径不是原实验的连续轨迹。原研究还用抑制处理检验其它解释。可以移动，也不等于每个蛋白都毫无限制。固定一个，其余还会混合吗？
draftNarration.en: Samples taken at different times show the two origins initially separated, then mixed. Fixed positions predict continued separation after forty minutes, unlike the observation. Now switch to an explanatory motion model. The ringed marker retains its origin while moving randomly. This one-dimensional closed path is not a continuous historical recording. The original study also tested alternatives with inhibitors. Mobility does not mean every protein is unrestricted. Anchor one: can the others still mix?

title.zh: 怎样把不同证据放进同一张膜？
title.en: How can one membrane model satisfy different evidence?

caption.zh: 面积、亲疏水与运动共同约束结构。
caption.en: Area, water affinity and motion constrain structure.

question.zh: 双层、镶嵌和流动，各解决了什么问题？
question.en: What do a bilayer, embedded proteins and mobility each explain?

storyboard.phenomenon: 独立入口先重演约2A面积和同源标记混合，而不是开口说“这些证据”。
storyboard.evidence: 面积支持双层，水接触约束头尾朝向，抗原混合支持可动；蛋白嵌入位置结合成分/蛋白性质等额外证据，不能归功于融合单实验。
storyboard.bridge: 同一几何模型同时保持稳定双层方向和膜面内运动；具有亲水外露区/疏水跨膜区的代表蛋白与环境相容。

prediction.zh: 把两层的头尾翻转，还是同样数量的分子，模型为什么不合适？
prediction.en: Why does flipping the same number of lipids make the model unsuitable?

beats.name: evidence-recall
beats.visual: 约2A面积观测、来源颜色混合依次短复现，视窗内图像不是抽象打勾表格。
beats.causalPurpose: 独立教材入口也能看到结论的依据。

beats.name: water-contact
beats.visual: 两侧明确水相，脂质头朝外、尾向内；把一个错误翻向的脂质转回时保持ID与尾长。
beats.causalPurpose: 用亲疏水相容性解释方向；不画分子有意避水。

beats.name: protein-environment
beats.visual: 代表跨膜蛋白用浅色亲水端与深色疏水腰，腰与膜芯相接；额外“蛋白性质与定位研究”的小来源标志。
beats.causalPurpose: 蛋白嵌入由其它证据与化学性质支持，抗原混合不独自证明深度。

beats.name: dynamic-not-disordered
beats.visual: 视角切至膜面，部分标记扩散、一枚有锚；双层仍完整，糖链只在外侧。
beats.causalPurpose: 运动与有序空间关系可以并存。

draftNarration.zh: 一个好的膜模型，要同时解释不同证据。提取脂质的约两倍面积支持双层；来源标记能混合，说明膜成分可以移动。再看分子的性质：亲水头接触两侧的水，疏水尾留在内部。蛋白质的性质和定位研究还支持不同嵌入方式，不能只靠融合实验确定它们的深度。流动镶嵌把这些约束放在一起：位置可以变，头尾方向和内外关系仍然保持。
draftNarration.en: A membrane model must satisfy different evidence. The roughly doubled extracted-lipid area supports a bilayer; marker mixing supports mobility. Molecular properties add another constraint: hydrophilic heads contact water, while nonpolar tails remain inside. Protein properties and localization studies support different embedding arrangements; fusion alone does not establish their depth. The fluid mosaic combines these constraints. Positions may change while molecular orientation and the distinction between inside and outside remain.

title.en: Does the model explain, or merely resemble?

caption.zh: 用证据检验模型，也检验它的局限。
caption.en: Evidence tests a model and its limits.

question.zh: 一个漂亮的固定模型，为什么仍不足以表现真实膜？
question.en: Why is an attractive rigid model still incomplete?

storyboard.phenomenon: 两个用回收盒/细线做出的模型数量相同，但一个头尾倒向水；两个方向正确模型则只在能否运动上不同。
storyboard.evidence: 片内重现亲水接触原则与标记分区→混合的观察；保留P46回收材料活动身份，主要任务是检验解释能力。
storyboard.bridge: 先以几何接触检验结构，再以移动能力检验行为；固定教具可表示空间关系但不能演示扩散，缺点不使其空间信息全错。

prediction.zh: 怎样改动连接方式，既保留双层方向又允许标记改变邻居？
prediction.en: How could a connection preserve bilayer orientation while allowing markers to change neighbors?

beats.name: orientation-challenge
beats.visual: 可信盒形头+双线尾材料；放在标示水相的截面中，错误尾部接水以接触高亮揭示；旋转视角保留对象身份。
beats.causalPurpose: 模型优劣由解释与已知性质判断，不靠材料漂亮。

beats.name: repair
beats.visual: 把对应一排材料转回，糖链置外侧、跨膜蛋白跨度不变；同数量与尺寸，不增删凑正确图。
beats.causalPurpose: 几何规则可直接校核。

beats.name: behavior-test
beats.visual: 片内回看真实分布从分区变混合；固定铁丝上的同源标记不能更换邻居，反事实仍分区。
beats.causalPurpose: 独立build窗口具备现象—证据—模型检验链。

beats.name: prediction
beats.visual: 一个允许侧向滑动的概念连接放开，模型标记开始混合，双层方向保持；不声称材料教具模拟分子动力学。
beats.causalPurpose: 提出改进预测，而不是再列一遍制作步骤。

draftNarration.zh: 用废旧材料做一张膜，怎样判断它解释得对不对？先把水的位置标出来：头应该接触水，尾不能朝外暴露。数量相同，方向错了仍然不合适。再用标记混合来检验：固定铁丝能表示双层，却不能展示分子换邻居。怎样让连接允许侧向移动，同时保持头尾方向？模型的价值，是保留要解释的关系，并说清它省略了什么。
draftNarration.en: How do we judge a membrane built from reused materials? Mark the water first. Heads should contact it, with tails shielded inside. The same number of pieces in the wrong orientation is still unsuitable. Now test behavior against marker mixing. Rigid wire represents a bilayer but prevents components from changing neighbors. Could a movable connection preserve orientation while allowing lateral motion? A useful model retains the relationships it explains and states what it leaves out.

sourceReview.title: 人教版高中生物学 必修1 分子与细胞
sourceReview.file: 人教版高中生物学-必修1-分子与细胞.pdf
sourceReview.access: 完整提取文本P40–46已重读，P42/P43/P46已实际渲染看图。
sourceReview.usedFor: 教材学习位置、原活动身份、历史推理链和结构范围。
sourceReview.limits: 教材把面积表述为恰2倍；影片用约2倍并保留教材原题。

sourceReview.title: Gorter & Grendel: On bimolecular layers of lipoids on the chromocytes of the blood
sourceReview.access: 5页原论文全文提取已读，P442 Table I扫描实际查看；Caltech托管原扫描。
sourceReview.usedFor: 独立面积测量逻辑；人细胞两条面积数据；原文承认蒸发阶段可损失材料，面积估计依赖细胞尺寸。
sourceReview.limits: 原表数据并非理想整数。动画40个同占地分子只是几何模型，不是原测得分子数。不要用这些旧数据测量现代真实膜厚或每分子面积。

sourceReview.title: Frye & Edidin: The rapid intermixing of cell surface antigens after formation of mouse human heterokaryons
sourceReview.access: 出版者完整abstract实际读取；PDF入口重定向到付费摘要，未取得17页全文。
sourceReview.usedFor: 37℃、5min到40min分布变化及超过90%异核体混合；原研究用间接荧光抗体、分时取样，并用抑制处理检验替代解释。
sourceReview.limits: 没有原始连续单蛋白轨迹；不把40min的细胞群体比例当每个分子的扩散概率。抑制结果不独自排除全部膜内吞回插机制。

sourceReview.title: Singer & Nicolson: The Fluid Mosaic Model of the Structure of Cell Membranes
sourceReview.access: 12页原扫描已取得；本轮实际阅读并查看P720–722及Fig1/2，不宣称通读全部12页。
